extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, publishers, journalists and anyone seeking information about IPSO (funding, independence, complaints, data handling)
extracted.subtask_description: A short FAQ page describing IPSO's funding, independence, complaints procedure, data handling and contact practices. It answers practical questions about how IPSO operates and how to interact with the organisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPSO funding and financial independence
rubrics_metrics.description: IPSO is financed by the Regulatory Funding Company (RFC) which is funded by member publishers. IPSO carries out its work separately and completely independently from its members. We have agreed 5 year budgets with the RFC, which give us certainty over our income and guarantee our freedom from control or influence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains source of funds (RFC funded by member publishers) and the safeguards (separate operation and 5-year agreed budgets) intended to guarantee independence from publishers.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPSO independence and board/committee composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Yes. IPSO is a self-regulator paid for by publishers which are members but carries out its work independently from them. IPSO’s Board and Complaints Committee both have independent majorities who have no connections with the newspaper and magazine industry. The other members have recent senior experience in the newspaper or magazine industries and therefore have expertise in the area of press standards. None are currently serving editors of publications that are or could be regulated by IPSO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out the organisational rule that independent majorities sit on the Board and Complaints Committee, and that other members bring industry experience but are not current serving editors — a statement of governance intended to support impartiality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom of Information (FOI) applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: IPSO is not a public body and is not subject to FOI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although not FOI-subject, IPSO states a transparency commitment: 'IPSO is committed to being transparent so will wherever possible and appropriate try to answer any queries.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Work experience policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Unfortunately IPSO cannot offer work experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If seeking work experience at a publication regulated by IPSO, applicants must contact those publications directly; IPSO does not place or host work experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for IPSO speakers at events
rubrics_metrics.description: Can someone from IPSO speak at my event? Please contact us with further details about your requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural: event organisers should contact IPSO with event details to request a speaker — no further eligibility or selection criteria given on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing information about Board and Complaints Committee members
rubrics_metrics.description: Where can I find out more about IPSO’s Board and Complaints Committee? Read about Board and Complaints Committee members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directs readers to a dedicated page for biographies/details of the Board and Complaints Committee — implies transparency via published membership information.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to make complaints about IPSO (outside review process)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complaints about IPSO which fall outside the complaints review process should be made in writing to the Chief Executive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural requirement: such complaints must be written and addressed to the Chief Executive; contact details are provided elsewhere on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal data processing information
rubrics_metrics.description: What does IPSO do with the personal data it collects? You can find information about IPSO’s processing of personal data here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points to a separate privacy/data-processing page for full details — indicates that IPSO maintains published information about its handling of personal data.
